Summary Description: Dr. Samuel Cheng is a multi-disciplinary AI systems researcher whose work spans privacy-preserving and verifiable distributed learning, security-sensitive AI for media and health, and scalable neural network architectures. He co-authored systematic and technical contributions on deepfake detection and generative AI safety, advanced zero-knowledge proof methods and polynomial proxies for verifiable federated learning, diffusion-model-based weakly supervised medical anomaly detection, and non-iterative cluster routing and entropy-aware capsule networks. His research emphasizes practical, secure, and scalable AI solutions across distributed networks, healthcare imaging, and intelligent edge computing, with a strong emphasis on evaluative rigor, reproducibility, and cross-domain impact.
